hero.title: Build your website in an afternoon
hero.subtitle: Edit every word and image on this page from the CMS. Changes appear here as you type.

items.title: Fast
items.text: Pages load in under a second.

items.question: Can I undo a change?
items.answer: Yes. Reset a section to go back to its default content.

items.question: Do visitors see drafts?
items.answer: No. Only published content is shown on the live site.
